environment.fixture: tests/fixtures/ssh (M00-T03) hm-m00t03-ca1, brought up fresh by tests/native/g04/fresh_run.sh in review-g04 rerun-20261003T184245Z; loopback port only

commands_or_harness: per run: dedicated HOME=<tmp> ssh-agent -U -a <tmp>/agent.sock; disposable ed25519 key + fixture-CA certificate (principal p-host1, valid_before = now+40 s); master ssh -o ControlMaster=yes -o ControlPersist=10m -N -f; raw mux protocol v4 client (python, SCM_RIGHTS fd passing) on the control socket; ssh -O stop; ssh -O check; ssh -o ControlPath=<old> -o PubkeyAuthentication=no

observed_result.criterion: After ssh -O stop has returned rc 0 (MUX_S_OK), no new session is admitted through the master by any client, including a mux control connection that was accepted before the stop and is idle until after it (the design's 'Race: 0 admissions after MUX_S_OK', spec P06 'stop admissions through a verified control operation'). Fail: any such admission.
observed_result.summary: Both runs: a raw mux client connected to the control socket (hello exchanged) BEFORE -O stop. The certificate expired; a fresh login was refused (rc 255, 'Certificate invalid: expired'). -O stop rc 0; control socket removed; -O check rc 255; master kept running as 'ssh: [stopped mux]'; a new client with the old ControlPath and PubkeyAuthentication=no was refused (rc 255). The pre-connected client then sent MUX_C_NEW_SESSION 2.0 s (run1) and 15.0 s (run2) after -O stop returned: the master replied MUX_S_SESSION_OPENED and ran the remote command as account cert (stdout marker present, exit 0), with no new TCP connection and no new Accepted line, 7.7 s / 20.6 s after valid_before. -O stop stops new control connections, not requests on control connections it already accepted; the idle control connection also kept the stopped master alive until the session ran.

limitations: OpenSSH mechanism evidence on one client/server pair (host OpenSSH_10.3p1 Apple build; source reasoning from openssh-portable mux.c @87f0cd1). No Heimdall code ran.

The pre-connected client is a same-user process that could reach the owner-only control socket before the stop; a benign client whose control connection is accepted just before the stop is the same case (consistent with the 'started_during_stop' admissions in the race records).
MUX_C_OPEN_FWD (new forwardings) on an existing control connection after stop was not tested; by the same source reasoning it is expected to be accepted [I].
